purpose: Teach: 秀逸/汽車/争っ/佳/奥行き/クアラルンプール/北上/代名詞

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新作の料理、本気で、秀逸やと、お客さん、本気で、絶対、感心してくれてはるで、本当に、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Aoi — that new dish you made is genuinely brilliant. Your customers are going to be absolutely impressed by it. I'm serious. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Loud, generous warmth. Kansai accent carried in rhythm and cadence. Opens big on Aoi's name. Emphatic conviction on the praise — building slightly. No hesitation. The kind of sincerity only given to people you trust.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。汽車をモチーフに、本気で、店内装飾、葵で、絶対、進めてみませんか、本気で、お客様、本気で、絶対、喜んでくださいそう。
lines.en: Yes. We could design the interior around a train motif, couldn't we? I think the customers would really love that.
lines.style: Warm, collaborative tone. Questioning lilt at the midpoint — inviting him in. Gentle, not pushing. The generosity of someone who notices ideas and makes space for them. Soft, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 業界で、本気で、絶対、争ってばかりではなく、絶対、独自性を、本気で、貫いていきたいんや、葵さん、本気で、絶対、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: That's exactly what I want — for us not to just compete with everyone else in the industry, but to hold onto what makes us different. You know?
lines.style: Sincere, quieter intensity. Opens conversational, not preachy. Slight pause before 'different' — weight on that word. The kind of earnest that comes from thinking about something for a long time. Steady pace, no rushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。私たちの店、本気で、佳作賞、コンテストで、絶対、いただきました、本気で、嬉しい、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、皆、頑張った。
lines.en: Yes. It means so much that we won that award at the contest. Everyone on the team worked so hard for that.
lines.style: Genuine warmth with underlying satisfaction. Opens gently on 'yes' — acknowledgment before celebration. Slight lift on 'won' — pride without performance. Trailing warmth on 'team' — inclusive, noticing everyone's contribution.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店の奥行きを、本気で、活かしたデザイン、葵さん、絶対、考えてみよか、本気で、お客さん、本気で、絶対、感心してくれるはずや、絶対。
lines.en: What if we design something that really takes advantage of the depth of the shop? The customers would absolutely notice that kind of thought.
lines.style: Animated, collaborative. Opening attack on 'What if' — he's building momentum. Leans forward in the voice. Conviction without pressure. The energy of someone sharing an idea he's already seen in his mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。クアラルンプールの料理、本気で、新メニューに、絶対、加えてみたいですね、葵で、本気で、お客様、絶対、興味、本気で、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I've been thinking — we could add Kuala Lumpur cuisine to the new menu. Something that would really interest our customers.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost dreaming. Slower opening, then gathering certainty. The tone of someone sitting with an idea, turning it over. Soft-edged, reflective. Warm but measured — she's testing it out loud.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 仕入れ、北上していく方向で、絶対、新鮮な、食材、本気で、確保していきたいんや、葵さん、本気で、絶対、本当に、本気で、頼むで、絶対。
lines.en: I want to make sure we're sourcing fresh ingredients from the northern regions. That's what I want to focus on. I'm counting on you for this.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful energy. 'Sourcing' lands with quiet weight. Animated but not rushed — the voice of someone who's made a decision. The last sentence — slight slowdown, genuine. Not demanding, asking. Trust underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。葵、本気で、地域の、お洒落カフェの、代名詞に、絶対、なれるよう、本気で、頑張ってまいります、本気で、絶対、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We're going to work hard to make Aoi the place people think of when they think about a stylish local café. Thank you for everything.
lines.style: Warm close with quiet resolve. Opens soft on 'yes' — agreement and gratitude woven together. Gentle buildup toward 'stylish local café' — vision without grandiosity. Final phrase — genuine, unhurried. The tone of someone wrapping up something that matters.
